objective: Define the smallest implementation boundary that may connect reviewed native parser output, explicit sidecar context, and reviewed stage authority to the existing sidecar stage launcher after the direct-launch run recorded direct_launch_handoff_failure, while keeping this gate definition-only.

definition_decision.weakest_point: The source run accepted the expanded native option spelling but did not reach sidecar launch from the Verilator-facing process. This boundary defines where an implementation may connect the parser result to the existing sidecar launcher; it does not implement or prove that connection.
reason: the previous review accepted direct_launch_handoff_failure as honest evidence
patched-parser success and separate pulp_ita_mha 64x1 sidecar equivalence are prerequisites, not direct-launch authority
the next useful step is to constrain the implementation seam before changing runtime behavior
coverage_output_equivalence remains the only scoped correctness policy

failure_class_boundary.process_parse_failure: the Verilator-facing process rejects or fails before the expanded accelerator options are accepted
failure_class_boundary.missing_explicit_sidecar_context: native parser output exists but target/template/shape/source context is missing or ambiguous
failure_class_boundary.sidecar_authority_failure: reviewed stage authority is absent or mismatched for the scoped target/template/shape
failure_class_boundary.direct_launch_handoff_failure: parser output and sidecar context exist, but the implementation does not enter the sidecar stage launcher from the native path
failure_class_boundary.sidecar_stage_failure: the sidecar launcher is reached, but a scoped build/run stage fails before compare
failure_class_boundary.compare_failure: coverage_output_equivalence compare runs and records a mismatch
failure_class_boundary.timing_claim_without_measurement: timing or speedup is claimed without a separate timing gate

required_next_gate.name: review_verilator_native_option_parser_direct_command_path_native_invocation_direct_launch_handoff_implementation_boundary_gate
must_decide: whether the implementation boundary is narrow enough to review before code changes
whether the existing fixture and sidecar launcher are the only allowed initial code surfaces
whether generated command text, stage-plan metadata, parser success, wrapper execution, reports, and artifacts remain non-authoritative
whether the future run remains scoped to pulp_ita_mha 64x1 and coverage_output_equivalence
whether timing, arbitrary filelists, automatic allocation, runtime/ABI changes, raw-state equality, and production throughput remain non-claims
must_not_claim: direct Verilator sidecar execution by this definition

non_claims: not broad native Verilator option support
not automatic optimal GPU allocation for any design
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
